Hero.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer & Systems Architect
Hero.description: Welcome to the interactive Workfolio CV and protected Engineering Knowledge Base. Instead of a static PDF resume, this monorepo itself is a live architectural proof: from end-to-end Zod contracts and HttpOnly JWT cookies to an IndexedDB Offline-First cache, D3.js graphs, and a reactive Server-Sent Events stream.
Hero.calloutTitle: How this project is built (Notion Workfolio + Production Full-Stack)
Hero.pillar1Desc: Clicking Base of Knowledge in the header opens a RHF + Zod micro-form, issues an HttpOnly JWT cookie, and broadcasts a live event over SSE.
Hero.pillar2Desc: All TanStack Query v5 requests sync with the browser's IndexedDB database (24h TTL) — articles and metrics load in 0ms even offline.
Hero.pillar3Desc: In the TanStack Table below, every technology includes a structured Why / Where / How breakdown of its role in this monorepo.

senior.role: Senior Full-Stack TypeScript Engineer / System Architect
senior.h1: Architected and migrated frontend and backend applications into a unified pnpm + Turborepo monorepo (Next.js App Router + NestJS + shared Zod contracts and UI kit).
senior.h2: Engineered an Offline-First client caching layer with TanStack Query v5 + IndexedDB, reducing redundant metadata API reads by 55%.
senior.h3: Implemented distributed telemetry using @nestjs/microservices (TCP/Redis) and Server-Sent Events (SSE) for real-time session monitoring.

fullstack.h1: Built the company design system on Tailwind CSS + Radix UI (shadcn/ui) with full visual documentation in Storybook.
fullstack.h2: Migrated authentication from vulnerable LocalStorage tokens to HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax cookies with GUEST / USER / ADMIN RBAC.
fullstack.h3: Optimized Prisma ORM queries on PostgreSQL (Neon) and standardized CI/CD pipelines with Biome.js and multi-stage Docker images.

KnowledgeBase.howToAddTitle: How to add a new multilingual article to the Knowledge Base:
KnowledgeBase.howToAddBody: Create a .en.mdx, .uk.mdx, or .ru.mdx file inside apps/web/content/[category]/ (typescript, react, nestjs-prisma, architecture-devops). generateStaticParams() automatically includes it in the SSG build and sidebar.
